---
name: Feature Request ✨
about: Suggest an idea for improvement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''
---

## 🎯 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Motivation

Why would this feature be valuable? What problem does it solve?

## 📐 Proposed Solution

How do you envision this feature working?

## 🔄 Alternative Approaches

Are there other ways to implement this?

## 📊 Additional Context

- Links to related issues or discussions
- Examples from other tools or projects
- Any other relevant context

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] I've searched for existing feature requests
- [ ] This doesn't duplicate an existing issue
- [ ] The feature aligns with project goals
